metadata.source_note: Minimal contract to bridge local EVENT:CREATURE_DIES to payoff ACTIONs without changing scoring or parser.

bridge_kind.label: creature_dies -> payoff_actions
bridge_kind.purpose: Enable local pairing between CREATURE_DIES listeners and payoff ACTION producers without changing global scoring.

activation_scope.description: Bridge applies only within the same local card/profile that already contains both the CREATURE_DIES listener and the payoff action producer.

causal_mode.description: Bridge encodes a narrow causal compatibility for local pairing only; it does not infer new global causes or effects.

non_goals: Global or fuzzy matching of payoff families
future_extension_points: Additional payoff actions with explicit evidence
Multi-hop causal modeling with separate contract
Replacement/prevention handling in a dedicated phase

bridge_rules.applies_when: Same local card/profile has consumed EVENT:CREATURE_DIES and produced one of the payoff ACTION targets.
bridge_rules.guardrails: No activation when CREATURE_DIES is absent or payoff action is absent in that local profile.
bridge_rules.notes: Bridge is strictly local to the profile that already contains both signals.

bridge_rules.applies_when: Bridge is active for a local profile.
bridge_rules.emits: pairing_support_only (no key remap outside declared targets)
bridge_rules.guardrails: Do not convert ACTION keys into EVENT keys globally.
bridge_rules.notes: Avoids broad key coercion or heuristic expansion.

bridge_rules.guardrails: No changes to weights, SOS, or edge ranking.

textual_or_semantic_requirements: Profile produces at least one of ACTION:LOSE_LIFE / ACTION:DEAL_DAMAGE / ACTION:GAIN_LIFE

reasons: Defers richer ontology to later phases
